description: Three cream claws on a brown scaled foot, cut clean at the joint. An Emberjaw's still holds its heat.
lore: An [[monsters/lava_salamander|Emberjaw]]'s foot comes off the black rock warm and stays warm, and every keeper on the cold rounds has wanted one at four in the morning. What the sellers leave out — because it is bad for business, and because it takes years to notice — is that the warmth is not a property of the foot. It is a property of how often the foot gets talked about.

A keeper on the north circuit held hers hot for nine winters by telling the same story over it most nights, to whoever was sitting there: where she got it, what the animal was doing, what the rock smelled like underneath. Then she got tired of the story. She says she can close her hand round it now and feel nothing at all, and she tells people that instead, which works, and which she finds a good deal funnier than they do.
gm_notes: Law II demonstrated on an object rather than a person. The floor under the joke: the new story is also a telling, so the foot is warming again while she goes around saying it is cold. Never state the mechanism in shipped text.
